{{Top|leg}}
'''Magda Gara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was the daughter of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] magnate [[Cilyn Gara]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Cilyn was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kodi Vilthar]] and after Vilthar was sighted on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], Madga hired a group of agents to capture Vilthar and bring the assassin to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], so that Vilthar could face justice for causing her father's death.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
